title: Calmodulin interacts with androglobin and regulates the nitrite reductase activity
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2025, 6,175-181
DOI: 10.1039/D4CB00245H, Communication
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Lv-Suo Nie, Xi-Chun Liu, Hui Han, Zhi-Hao Ren, Shu-Qin Gao, Ying-Wu Lin
The structure of the fifth mammalian globin, androglobin (Adgb), and its complex with calmodulin (CaM) were predicted using AlphaFold3 and HDOCK, and the binding of CaM was shown to enhance the nitrite reductase activity of Adgb.
